extDescription.message: No-code / vibe coding tool recommendations and step-by-step guide for non-developers

awaitingSurveyText.message: Please complete the survey in the new tab.

awaitingSurveyHint.message: After clicking Start guide, you can open the extension icon to view the guide here.

backendRequiredDesc.message: Enter the backend server URL in settings to use AI guidance.

surveyQuestion1.message: What kind of website do you want to build?

surveyHint1.message: e.g. Landing page, store, blog, membership site

surveyPlaceholder.message: Describe the website you want in your own words.

surveyErrorNoTools.message: Could not find recommended tools. Please describe a bit more specifically.

aiStudioStep1.message: Copy the website idea prompt from the survey and paste it into the top input.

aiStudioStep2.message: Click the Build button to the right of the input to generate the first version of the app.

aiStudioStep5.message: Click Add secret to get API keys for each page.

aiStudioStep6.message: Enter what you want to change in the chat on the right, then use the Annotate app button to modify specific parts.
